meta.name: arize-evaluator
meta.description: INVOKE THIS SKILL for LLM-as-judge evaluation workflows on Arize: creating/updating evaluators, running evaluations on spans or experiments, tasks, trigger-run, column mapping, and continuous monitoring. Use when the user says: create an evaluator, LLM judge, hallucination/faithfulness/correctness/relevance, run eval, score my spans or experiment, ax tasks, trigger-run, trigger eval, column mapping, continuous monitoring, query filter for evals, evaluator version, or improve an evaluator prompt.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大模型自动评估LLM输出的质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化评估LLM输出的准确性、幻觉或相关性。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically evaluate LLM output quality with AI judges
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate evaluation of LLM outputs for accuracy, hallucination, or relevance.

howto.what: 当你需要评估AI模型的回答质量时，Claude能帮你创建或管理评估器（LLM裁判），运行评估任务，并设置持续监控。它可处理列映射和触发评估运行。
howto.when: 当你提到“创建评估器”、“运行评估”、“评估实验”等关键词，或要求进行幻觉、正确性等评估时。

say.text: 运行评估任务，覆盖今天的所有跨度。
say.note: 会触发一次一次性评估。

say.text: 对实验A的结果进行评分，使用已有的“正确性”评估器。
say.note: 会将评估器应用于实验数据。

howto.what_en: When you need to evaluate AI model outputs, Claude can create or manage LLM-as-judge evaluators, run evaluation tasks, and set up continuous monitoring. It also handles column mapping and trigger runs.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like 'create an evaluator', 'run eval', 'score my experiment', or ask for hallucination/correctness assessment, etc.

say_en.text: Create an evaluator for 'Playground Traces' project to check answer correctness.
Run an evaluation task covering all spans today.
Score experiment A using the existing 'correctness' evaluator.
